name: ComMarker Omni XE UV
tagline: Expanded UV platform for larger glass and plastic work
tldr: Omni XE sits between Omni 1 and Omni X in ComMarker's UV lineup : check current specs for bed size and power. UV remains specialized: glass, plastics, fine detail.
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

pros: Expanded UV platform for larger glass and plastic work
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 120 × 120 mm typical on this chassis
5W on ComMarker Omni XE UV: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~6–12 min
Reference cut job on this module: Not a cutter
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 4 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 4 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 5W module on ComMarker Omni XE UV. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed
